description: Trigger evals for dv:ticket (file a Linear ticket in the agreed format from a rough request, or groom an existing ticket against it). Hard near-misses in no_trigger: doing the work a ticket describes, reading a ticket's status, GitHub issues and PRs, a handoff (dv:handoff) and a plan critique (dv:critique). See tooling/evals/README.md.
